title: Rex
subtitle: No Other Option
text: Action [Exhaust, ready an exhausted enemy unit]: The next event you play this phase costs 1 resource less.
deployBox: On Attack: You may ready an exhausted enemy unit. If you do, the next event you play this phase costs 2 resources less.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: The cost reduction from Rex's “On Attack” ability remains active even if he is defeated.
